answer: Hash model weights and runtime fingerprint when a task starts. Publish both with the receipt so a duplicate deployment shows the same crystal twice. Draw auditors from a rotating pool keyed by epoch, and re-queue contested receipts for a second panel. Price it: three hours of jury time per dispute, paid again on appeal. A cloned fleet meets that bill once per clone. The ridge between honest and copied work holds while fingerprints stay distinct, and each dawn brings a model release that can blur it.
